svg.text: where the OTHER end goes (TO MB / TO TOOLHEAD sit at the PSU; 24V / 24V IN at the device). A and B must land on the two TMC5160 ports and nowhere

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: else — on a 2209 the motor is badly under-driven. Never plug or unplug a stepper, or the Micro-Fit umbilical, with power on.
